coordinateSystem.prototype: Three.js Y-up; horizontal XZ; height is Y
coordinateSystem.unreal: Unreal Z-up; prototype X maps to Unreal X, prototype Z maps to Unreal Y, prototype height maps to Unreal Z

formula: phase = 2π * (dot(normalize(direction), horizontalPosition) / wavelength - speed * time / wavelength) + phaseOffset; height += amplitude * sin(phase)
normal: derive tangent from dHeightDx and dHeightDz of the same wave field, then normalize(-dHeightDx, 1, -dHeightDz)
unrealPortGate: Do not port shader parameters until browser smoke, visible waves, foam fade, boundary preview and overlay evidence pass.
